day_local: Axadda sagaal iyo labaatanaad ee wakhtiga caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, jacaylka Ilaaha Aabbaha ah, iyo wada-jirka Ruuxa Quduuska ah ha idinla jiraan.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
homily:
Waxaa jira saacado maalinta ka mid ah, gaar ahaan markii qorraxdu ay bilaabato inay hoos u dhacdo, oo gurigu uu noqdo mid aamusan, halkaas oo xusuustu ay si tartiib ah u soo gasho qolka. Waxaad arki kartaa wax yar oo maalinle ah: laga yaabee inay tahay diyaarad yar oo uu Ben ku ciyaari jiray, ama buug uu dhigay miiska, ama xataa xusuusta qosolkiisa markuu ka hadlayo 'con chim airlines'. Waxyaalahan yaryar, oo aan muhiim u muuqan, ayaa ah meesha aan maanta ka bilaabayno. Waxay yihiin xusuus muujinaysa in nolosha Benjamin Vo ay ahayd mid dhab ah, mid qurux badan, oo weli halkan nala joogta. 

Waxaan maanta dooraneynaa hal sawir oo nala socda: waa sawirka 'qadaadiicda' ama lacagta. Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu weydiiyay su'aal aad u fudud laakiin qoto dheer: 'Whose image is this and whose inscription?' (Yaa iska leh sawirkan iyo qoraalkan?). Bal ka feker sawirkaas. Qadaadiicda waxaa ku qoran sawirka Kaysar, laakiin qof kasta oo inaga mid ah, waxaa ku qoran sawirka Ilaah. Benjamin wuxuu ahaa wiil sawirkaas Ilaah si qurux badan u xambaarsanaa. Wuxuu ahaa wiil leh maskax aad u fiiqan, oo yaqaanay sida loo darsado AWS environments, ama sida loo qoro koodhka GitHub, laakiin wuxuu kaloo ahaa wiil arkayay waxa dadka kale aysan arag: baahida dadka kale iyo jacaylka qoyskiisa. Wuxuu ahaa wiil jecel inuu barto diyaaradaha, isagoo maskaxdiisa ku dhisayay shirkad uu u bixiyay 'con chim airlines', halkaas oo uu ka qosli jiray oo uu si farxad leh uga sheekeyn jiray. 

Laakiin intaanan halkaas sii marin, waa inaan si daacad ah u wajahno xanuunka weyn ee maanta halkan yaalla. Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay yihiin kuwo qoto dheer oo culayskooda wata. Waxaa jira saacado marka qorraxdu dhacdo ama marka gurigu aamuso, oo aad dareemaysaan inaysan jirin wax buuxin kara cisrigaas banaanka ah. Waxaan rabaa inaan halkan ku hakinno. Waxaan rabaa inaan idiin sheego runta: Ilaah wuu idin arkaa. Wuxuu arkaa oohintiinna, wuxuu arkaa dadaalkiinna, wuxuu arkaa jacaylka aad weli u hayso Ben. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah. 

Oo halkaas ayay nuurku ka soo galayaa qolka mugdiga ah. Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Then repay to Caesar what belongs to Caesar and to God what belongs to God.' (Markaasaa wuxuu ku yidhi, Haddaba waxa Kaysar iska leh sii Kaysar, oo waxa Ilaah iska lehna sii Ilaah.) Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil Masiixa ku qirtay noloshiisa. Wuxuu ahaa wiil leh qalbi saafi ah oo mar walba diyaar u ahaa inuu dadka kale la wadaago waxa uu haysto. Xusuusnow sida uu u rabay inuu u huro lacagtiisa si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas saafi ah ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa dabeecadda wiilkan qalbiga wanaagsan. Taasi waa waxa ay ka dhigan tahay in lagu dhex noolaado xornimada Masiixa. Bawlos, akhriska labaad, wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'We give thanks to God always for all of you, remembering you in our prayers, unceasingly calling to mind your work of faith and labor of love.' (Annagu Ilaah mar walba waanu idiinku mahadnaqnaa, annagoo ducadayada idinku xusuusanayna). Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil loo doortay inuu iftiimiyo adduunkan. Hadda, Ben wuxuu ku jiraa meel ka sarreysa daruuraha, meel aanay jirin xanuun ama daal. Wuxuu ku jiraa 'Banquet of Heaven'. Ma jiro baahi loo qabo inuu dhisayo 'con chim airlines', waayo wuxuu ku jiraa meel uu ka arki karo adduunka oo dhan, isagoo dhoola caddaynaya. 

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in mararka qaarkood aad dareemeyso in kursigaaga agtiisa uu yahay mid cidlo ah. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu ku jiro xusuustaada, riyooyinkaaga, iyo jacaylka aad wadaagteen. Ha ka cabsin inaad horay u socoto. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Wuxuu rabaa inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay: 'Ha ka baqina, waayo waxaan idin sugayaa meel aan dhimasho lahayn.' 

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in sawirka Ilaah uu idinku dhex yaallo. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.

petitions.opening: Aan u duceyno Rabbiga isagoo aamin ah:
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyay ee aaday gacmaha Ilaah, inuu Rabbigu siiyo nabad iyo iftiin joogto ah, aan Rabbiga u ducayno.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan iyo kuwa culayska xambaarsan, in Ilaah u soo dejiyo raaxo, rajo, iyo xoog ay ku sii wadaan nolosha, aan Rabbiga u ducayno.

spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan rumeeyey inaad joogto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kugu jeclahay wax walba, waxaana rabaa inaan ku qaato naftayda. Maadaama aanan hadda kuu qaadan karin si sacramental ah, fadlan qalbigayga ku imow si ruuxi ah. Waxaan kugu soo dhaweynayaa sidii adigoo horey u joogay, waxaana naftayda gebi ahaanba kuugu xirayaa adiga. Waligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin ilaaliyo, oo ha idin siiyo nabaddiisa. Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Aamiin.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Sidan ayuu Rabbigu ku yidhi subkiddiisii, Kuros, ka aan gacantiisa midig qabsaday, si aan quruumaha hortiisa ugu hoosaysiiyo, oo aan boqorrada dhex-dooda ka furfuro, si aan albaabbada hortiisa ugu furo, oo aanan irdaha u xidhin: Jacoob addoonkayga aawadiis, iyo Israa'iil ka aan doortay aawadiis, ayaan magacaaga kuugu yeedhay, oo aan kuu bixiyey magac, in kastoo aadan i aqoon. Anigu waxaan ahay Rabbiga, mana jiro mid kale, Ilaah kale oo aan aniga ahayn ma jiro. Anigaa ku hubaysiiyey, in kastoo aadan i aqoon, si ay dadku xagga bari iyo xagga galbeedba uga ogaadaan inaanan aniga mooyee mid kale jirin. Anigu waxaan ahay Rabbiga, mana jiro mid kale.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: Rabbiga u gabya gabay cusub; Rabbiga u gabya, idinkoo dunida oo dhan ah. Ammaantiisa u sheega quruumaha dhexdiisa, iyo shuqulladiisa yaabka leh dadka oo dhan. Waayo, Rabbigu waa weyn yahay, aad buuna u ammaan badan yahay; isagu waa mid laga cabsado oo ka sarreeya ilaahyada oo dhan. Waayo, ilaahyada quruumaha oo dhammu waa wax aan waxba tarin, laakiin Rabbigu wuxuu sameeyey samooyinka. Rabbiga siiya, idinkoo reeraha quruumaha ah, Rabbiga siiya ammaan iyo xoog; Rabbiga siiya ammaanta magaciisa u qalanta! Hadiyad u keena, oo barxadihiisa soo gala. Rabbiga ku caabuda dharka quduuska ah; dhulka oo dhammu hortiisa ha gariireen; quruumaha dhexdiisa ku yidhaahda, Rabbigu waa boqor; isagu dadka wuxuu ku xukumi doonaa caddaalad.

readings.label: Akhriska Labaad
readings.text: Baabulos, Silwanos, iyo Timoteyos, waxay qorayaan kaniisadda reer Tesaloniika oo ku dhex jirta Ilaaha Aabbaha ah iyo Rabbiga Ciise Masiix: Nimco iyo nabad ha idinla jirto. Mar walba Ilaah waanu idiinku mahadnaqnaa dhammaantiin, annagoo ducadayada idinku xusuusanayna, annagoo aan joogsi lahayn xusuusanayna shuqulkaaga iimaanka, iyo hawsha jacaylka, iyo samirka rajada Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, hortiisa Ilaaheenna iyo Aabbaha ah, annagoo og, walaalayaal, in Ilaah idin jecel yahay, iyo sida laydiin doortay. Waayo, injiilkayagu idiinma iman eray oo kaliya, laakiin wuxuu idiin yimid xoog iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah iyo hubanti badan.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Markaasay Fariisiyiintii tageen, oo waxay qorsheeyeen sidii ay Ciise ugu dabin lahaayeen hadalkiisa. Waxay u direen xertiisii iyo Herodosiyiintii, oo waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Macallimow, waannu og nahay inaad tahay nin run ah, oo aad jidka Ilaah u bartid runta, oo aadan cidna u aabayeelin, waayo, dadka ma kala soocdid. Haddaba noo sheeg, maxaad u malaynaysaa? Ma bannaan yahay in Kaysar canshuur la siiyo mise ma bannaan yahay? Laakiin Ciise wuxuu ogaa xumaantooda, wuxuuna ku yidhi, Maxaad ii jirrabaysaan, idinkoo munaafaqiin ah? I tusi qadaadiicda canshuurta. Markaasay u keeneen qadaadiicdii Roomaanka. Wuxuuna ku yidhi, Yaa iska leh sawirkan iyo qoraalkan? Waxay ku yidhaahdeen, Kaysar. Markaasuu ku yidhi, Haddaba waxa Kaysar iska leh sii Kaysar, oo waxa Ilaah iska lehna sii Ilaah.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!
